scope: Read-only cleanup/resource-accounting audit; this JSON is the only persistent audit mutation. No deletions, signals, MLX imports/model loads, or services changed.
runtime_snapshot_note: Training/model download may continue concurrently; these sizes are a point-in-time snapshot, not actual reclaimable SSD space.

root_checks: Dedicated non-symlink absolute root named lumen-local-*
process_controls: Each exec runs in a new session/process group
Only verified leader groups are signaled
Leaderless or unverifiable groups cause refusal
lsof recursively audits open files/cwd before root deletion; unrelated holders cause refusal
lifecycle_evidence.network_policy: HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE are 1 unless explicitly launched with manage.py exec --online. Download uses token=False and local_dir models.
lifecycle_evidence.deletion_semantics: Entire dedicated root permanently removed by shutil.rmtree after identity/open-file checks; symlink targets are not recursively followed. Does not clear global caches or stop KS KB/Docker/Ollama/browser services.

unscoped_artifact_conclusion: No recent files found in the five checked global cache directories. Absence is limited to these checks; OS-managed Metal/driver caches, filesystem snapshots and other application activity were not exhaustively attributed.
fixture_note: Earlier stdlib guard fixtures used TemporaryDirectory and were removed on context exit, including the failed fixture; later fixtures lived inside .tmp and were likewise removed. They are not model results.

preserve_before_cleanup.recommended_export: A small results-only directory or archive OUTSIDE the disposable root, with a SHA256 manifest and verified readback before deleting the root. The user requested a video/report, so preserve its deliverables and measurement evidence; do not silently retain weights or full virtualenv.
include: runs/ (raw before/after responses, resource JSON/JSONL, comparison/report, cleanup-audit.json, video HTML/script/assets and licenses)
common.py, prepare_data.py, run_eval.py, compare.py, resource_guard.py, manage.py, preflight.py, make_calibration.py, download_model.py

cleanup_steps.action: Wait for the active final measurement/inference job to finish; finalize the truthful comparison and video/report. Distinguish stopped 4B calibration from actual 1.7B training.
Export the intended report/evidence outside root; record exact export path, manifest, byte size and verify representative files/readback before removal.

cleanup_steps.effect: Read-only; collect last tracked processes and logical size.
Dry-run only. Review exact root/UUID/scope; no deletion.

Only after the preserved report has been verified and final cleanup is authorized: stop owned jobs, reject untracked holders, delete disposable root permanently. If refusal occurs, inspect the reported PIDs; never kill unrelated apps.

cleanup_steps.action: Verify root absence, absence of experiment Python/MLX processes, exported report readability and final disk free bytes. Show actual disk-free delta separately from estimated logical bytes; do not promise instantaneous SSD accounting or zero global OS cache.
